RDINARY IME CTOBER 25 2026 EARING SSISTANCE YSTEMS AND XPERIENCE UDIOLOGY special Thank you to parishioner Dr Jenny Wagner of Experience Audiology Earlier this week Dr Wagner donated and installed an Auracast transmitter into our church sound system This technology broadcasts church audio to Auracastenabled hearing aids allowing users to connect to our sound system and stream the systems audio directly to their devices Together with our existing hearing loop system this new transmitter will help even more parishioners be able to hear clearly as we join together in prayer and worship as a parish family We are grateful to Dr Wagner for sharing her time expertise and generosity with our parish She has also prepared a bulletin insert included this weekend that explains how to sync our hearing assistance systems with various hearing aids RAYING FOR THE IOCESAN YNOD Please keep our diocesan synod in your prayers Next weekend our parish representative Abraham Herr and I travel to South Bend for the opening two day session This gathering marks our dioceses first synod in 100 years second twoday session follows next month in Fort Wayne Pray that the Holy Spirit guides our conversations on how to best serve Christ and his Church ENOVATION ROJECT PDATE HERE RE OING As we reopened the sanctuary earlier this month I mentioned that work on our project was not yet complete We have a large number of millwork and finishing issues that still need to be addressed by our team from Shawnee Construction These outstanding concerns are significant enough that we do believe that they need to be properly addressed and corrected Throughout this process our architectural team William Heyer Architect has carefully documented these outstanding concerns most recently providing several pages of items requiring attention Last week our construction team proposed an approach to address a number of our various concerns We have requested a full report with this proposal explaining how each documented item will be addressed and the reasoning for any proposed exceptions Some of these concerns are readily visible particularly areas of cloudiness or discoloration in the wood finish Addressing them is expected to require sanding and refinishing throughout the church Our construction team has proposed performing this work inside the building Part of the requested report will need to detail how the created dust would be contained and controlled and how the surrounding furnishings and finishes would be protected In addition to this repair work we are also finalizing the details in with a decorative artist for the stencil work in the church While this work was initially part of the original bid with our construction team theyve since asked us to remove this from their scope of work and pursue it ourselves Part of the work will be delayed until the above repairs are complete but there are a number of areas that can be painted independent of that needed work OVEMBER EMORIAL ANDLES For more than ten years our parish has honored deceased loved ones with memorial candles burning throughout November Last year even after combining duplicate memorials we had more than 150 candles most of which are stored here at the parish With the renovations the statuary niches that previously held these candles are no longer available This year we will continue this remembrance in a new way through an annual Book of the Dead placed near the Bl Solanus Casey Shrine Here the names of our deceased loved ones will be inscribed as an invitation to remember them in prayer throughout November While the way we honor them will change our prayers for them remain at the heart of this tradition Saturday October 24 400445 pm Confession 5:00pm Herman
